# Class: ProcessHandle

Defined in: [src/specification/facets/\_common/process.ts:21](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/specification/facets/_common/process.ts#L21)

An external process, declared like any other service.

One shape for every one of them: a site's dev server, an API behind the
site, the bundler a simulator loads from. Without it each is declared
somewhere else — a facet option, a document's `serve:` entry, a `beforeAll`
spawning a child and an `afterAll` that sometimes forgets to kill it — and
the lifetime belongs to whoever remembered. Here it is the framework's.

It sits in a `services` record beside `postgres()`, `redis()` and
`sqlite()`, so it starts after them and can be handed their connection
strings through `env`, and it is stopped with the specification.

### serviceName


Defined in: [src/specification/facets/\_common/process.ts:28](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/specification/facets/_common/process.ts#L28)

The name this handle is known by. Left `null` until the orchestrator
assigns it at start time: it is the kebab-case form of the RECORD KEY,
so `{ analyticsDb: postgres() }` reports as `analytics-db` and reads its
init script from `docker/analytics-db/`. The key is the only name a
specification writes; a handle carries no second one of its own.

#### Implementation of

```ts

```

### isolation()

```ts
isolation(): IsolationStrategy;
```

Defined in: [src/specification/facets/\_common/process.ts:70](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/specification/facets/_common/process.ts#L70)

Isolation is the RUN's, not the worker's — and a run here is one
EVALUATION of the specification module. Under vitest's default
isolation that is once per test file, so two files that import the same
specification get a child each, with the id the facet minted for it.
Nothing is acquired or reset between tests: the id is what tells two
runs apart, never a label a spec samples.

#### Returns

[`IsolationStrategy`](../type-aliases/IsolationStrategy.md)

#### Implementation of

```ts
ServiceHandle.isolation
```
